name: Thyme

schedule.notes: Surface-sow; slow to germinate. Easier from cuttings or division.
Snip stems just before flowering for peak flavor; trim plant by a third after bloom.

harvest.cues: Stems 6+ in, leaves dense, just before flowering buds open. Strip leaves with thumb and forefinger.
harvest.storageNotes: Dries on the stem — bundle and hang. Tastes nearly as good fresh from a dried sprig.

varieties.name: Lemon Thyme
varieties.notes: Bright lemon scent. Great with fish.

varieties.name: Creeping Thyme
varieties.notes: Ground cover. Tougher leaves, less culinary.

notes: Wants lean, gravelly soil and full sun — overfed thyme is leggy and flavorless. Wood mulch holds too much water; use gravel.
